units.source_text: 古歌：“心地非由纱线织，离愁何故细如丝？”

en.t: An old poem says, "The heart is not woven from threads, so why is the sorrow of parting as fine as silk?"
It appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 作者纪贯之，亦三十六歌仙之一，生于十世纪初。

en.t: The author, Ki no Tsurayuki, was also one of the Thirty-Six Immortal Poets and was born in the early tenth century.
